scope: Finite fixed-DGP computational validation; not a universal theorem, market power, real-data confirmation or R3
primary_rule: all rivals in principal and, for EACH rival, at least two of three additional panels; existing effect/direction/CI and adverse-screen gates retained
inner_randomization_scope: The bootstrap seed is fixed independently of all data and common to panels and outer replicates. Validation is conditional on this deterministic inner Monte Carlo algorithm; no integration over a varying bootstrap seed is claimed.
scheduling: Round-robin scenarios within each outer replicate index; parallel execution preserves this ledger order.

criteria.CI99_witness_selection: First population-truth-fixed witness; principal first rival for the strong positive control. Two intervals: raw RMSE difference and relative gain.
criteria.variance_break_stress: Outside the stationarity theorem and explicitly adversarial, but NOT excluded from the predeclared pass criteria after observing results.

DGP_restrictions: 21 named systems remain in every analysis, all 120 Holm slots retained; only three stochastic rule classes in homogeneous cases, more in two heterogeneous cases.

Homogeneous cases have perfectly dependent fixed seeds. Conditional-cancellation and ranking-reversal cases have two heterogeneous seed groups; these restricted cases do not certify arbitrary seed heterogeneity.
The 19 non-witness rival rules have duplicate trajectories by design; they are not 19 statistically independent forecasting algorithms.
Positive lognormal squared losses have exactly known means; fixed-cohort theta is the mean of their population square roots.

Predictable instruments use the latent Gaussian factor at t-1, never a future innovation. Conditional GMM has a stronger vector null; its rejection under conditional cancellation is not mislabeled scalar type-I error.
composition_scope: False acceptance of the statistical direction/practical assertions. The witness proof does not certify all scientific adequacy, robustness, novelty or data-reserve requirements.
cost_policy: CPU is charged from completed replicas plus parent/worker startup/compiler overhead measured with RUSAGE_CHILDREN. Budget is checked between fixed batches; the final batch can overshoot the soft check. An unclosed session retains uncertainty and a lower-bound cost, never invented exact accounting.
